headline: Municipal Service Bottlenecks Erode Business Appeal of South Africa's Gauteng Province
summary: Substandard municipal services in Gauteng are eroding the economic appeal of South Africa's chief industrial province, even as Cape Town faces worsening housing affordability.
why: Gauteng generates more than a third of South Africa's gross domestic product, making local municipal reliability essential for commercial and industrial output.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Inadequate municipal infrastructure raises operational costs and hurts productivity for local enterprises.
